name: com.cosgunhalil.fixed-point-math
description: Deterministic fixed-point math for lockstep and rollback simulations. FP scalars (Q48.16, or Q32.32 with FPM_Q32_32), FP2 and FP3 vectors, exact 128-bit intermediates, square roots, table-based trigonometry and a seedable random generator, all bit-identical on every machine, platform and scripting backend. The core has no Unity dependency and is Burst-compatible; an optional assembly converts to and from Unity types, and a Roslyn analyzer keeps marked assemblies free of floats and other nondeterministic APIs.
